releaseNotes: IMPORTANT: Dunes has moved to a new app package, so this update installs as a NEW app with a new icon - your old Dunes stays until you remove it. After installing: 1) Open the NEW Dunes (you get a fresh ID), 2) If you have an @username, release it in the OLD app's Settings first, then claim it in the new app, 3) Re-add your contacts and share your new ID, 4) Uninstall the old Dunes. What's new: complete call reliability overhaul (no more dropped, ghost, or self-cancelling calls), remote video shows reliably, blocking works fully, messages never vanish, cancellable transfers, image previews, faster large-file sends, security hardening.
